text:
incident-bot: paging @Cleo @Liam @Maya — high ECC error rate detected on clearwave-vpc-pool node gpu-7b-3 in us-west-2a. error-rate: 120 errs/min, spike started 2419008700. Affected services: rw-serving-clearwave (95% of errors).
Cleo: on it. jumping in.
Liam: oncall-sre here. do we have customer impact?
Maya: runtime-eng — seeing increased inference failures and some garbled logits for a small subset of requests. looks like KV cache corruption, not total OOM.
Cleo: confirmed. Clearwave reports intermittent bad completions and some jobs retried. not entire pool, subset of shards on gpu-7b-3.
Angelica: @Cleo plugging in — Clearwave is an enterprise VPC customer with live inference jobs. they care about tail latency and consistency. please keep me in the loop, will draft a customer-safe update.
Liam: immediate plan: isolate node -> drain -> failover traffic to warm spares in same AZ. also tag for hardware replacement. Maya, any runtime-level mitigations while we drain?
Maya: yes — recommend switching active sessions routed by policy to quantized variant rw-open-13b-int8 on warm spares to reduce memory pressure and avoid KV behaviour that triggered corruption. can do an automatic model-variant fallback for this tenant only.
Cleo: run drain now. executing: `redwoodctl node drain gpu-7b-3 --pool clearwave-vpc-pool --reason "ECC spike"`
Cleo: output: `Initiating drain on gpu-7b-3. Evicting 18 sessions. Graceful window 120s. Marking node UNAVAILABLE for scheduling.`
runtime-bot: autoscaler: detected decreased capacity in clearwave-vpc-pool, launching warm instance warm-spare-cc-02 in us-west-2a. preloading model rw-open-13b-int8.
Maya: pushing tenant-level routing change: `redwoodctl routing set clearwave --fallback-model rw-open-13b-int8 --scope tenant`
Maya: change applied. routing now prefers int8 fallback for Clearwave sessions when node health degraded.
Darren: support lead — opened INC-2419-CLEARWAVE. assigning to SE @Angelica. Notifying account team.
Angelica: drafting message to customer: "We detected degraded completions from a small subset of requests. We've isolated the affected node and routed traffic to spares with a temporary model fallback. No persisted data was affected. We'll schedule hardware replacement and follow up with timeline." want to include any error counts?
Cleo: include error counts: 420 failed requests in last 10m, 2.3% of their traffic. note that failed outputs were partial and not data exfil.
Liam: we need hardware metadata for vendor: GPU SN: GW-TH-9982, Node HW tag: node-7b-3, Rack: r13-usw2a. Escalating RMA with vendor.
Maya: logs snippet (truncated):
```
[2419008687] gpu-7b-3 ecc: corrected=12 uncorrected=7
[2419008692] kvcache: checksum-mismatch session=cka9f
[2419008697] serve: error write output: corrupted-kv-entry
[2419008710] kernel: nvidia-driver-470 hang detected -> reset queued
```
Maya: looks like a mix of corrected/uncorrected ECC hits then driver reset. KV checksum mismatches align with request failures.
Cleo: good. drain progressed: 12/18 sessions successfully migrated, 6 sessions retried on warm-spare-cc-02. no retry storms.
Liam: confirm node quarantined from scheduler?
Cleo: `redwoodctl node set-availability gpu-7b-3 --available false --reason "quarantine ECC"` -> success.
runtime-bot: health-check: warm-spare-cc-02 reports model ready, 0 errors in last 30s, latency stable.
Maya: can we run canary validation against Clearwave prompt set?
Cleo: running smoke: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/serve/clearwave/test -d @smoke_prompts.json | jq '.status'`
Cleo: smoke results: 100/100 responses match expected patterns, no checksum errors.
Angelica: good — I'll send a short status update to Clearwave: "We've isolated the affected node, routed traffic to spares using an int8 fallback, and verified healthy responses. Replacement ordered. We'll share ETA once vendor confirms RMA." OK?
Darren: adding on-call notes to ticket: timeline, actions taken, command outputs zipped to incident record.
Liam: ensure we have trace ids for bad outputs to feed to evals team to check for regression in quantized variant. Maya, please flag any quality regressions from the int8 fallback.
Maya: will monitor. initial eval on canary prompts: small ROUGE change ~0.6% (within expected for quantization), no soft-failures.
Cleo: vendor RMA call placed. vendor provided replacement ETA 72h. hardware team scheduling hot-swap.
Liam: plan for follow-up: replace GPU, run burn-in, rejoin node to pool in maintenance window. if ECC recurs after rejoin -> disk-level issue or PCIe fabric fault, escalate to platform firmware.
Angelica: sending message now.
Angelica: message sent to Clearwave support contacts: "Status: degraded completions observed on subset of requests. Mitigation: isolated node, routed to warm spares with int8 fallback. Customer impact: ~2.3% of traffic affected, transient. Next update in 1h or on major status change." :white_check_mark:
Cleo: monitoring. handing off to night oncall @Liam in 30m — will update runbook and post final summary.
Liam: acknowledged. I'll keep watch and coordinate with hardware for the RMA.
runtime-bot: incident summary appended to INC-2419: node gpu-7b-3 quarantined, 18 sessions evicted, warm-spare-cc-02 serving Clearwave, routing fallback rw-open-13b-int8 applied, vendor RMA created.
incident-bot: incident state: mitigated. severity downgraded to SEV3.
Cleo: final note — KV cache is ephemeral. no customer persisted state touched. closing active page. follow-up action items: hardware RMA, postmortem with root-cause analysis, quantify any quality delta due to int8 fallback.
Liam: adding follow-up: schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 PST.
Darren: INC-2419 updated with actions and links to logs.
Angelica: I'll own customer postmortem comms. thanks team.
Cleo: thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: thread closed by Cleo at 2419009250.
